title: Drone on Ice
body: A drone is directed across a frictionless ice-covered lake. The mass of the drone is $$1.50\, \text{kg}$$, $$and$$ $$its$$ $$velocity$$ $$is$$ $$(3.00\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}$$. $$After$$ $$10.0\, \text{s}$$, $$the$$ $$velocity$$ $$is$$ $$(9.00\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}+(4.00\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{j}$$. $$A$$ $$constant$$ $$horizontal$$ $$force$$ $$causes$$ $$this$$ $$change$$ $$in$$ $$motion$$.
